actions.name: search_messages
actions.description: Search Slack messages visible to the connected user. Supports Slack search modifiers such as in:channel_name and from:<@UserID>.

count.description: The number of results to return per page.

page.description: The Slack page number to fetch.

cursor.description: The Slack cursor for cursormark pagination. Use '*' for the first request.

highlight.description: Whether Slack should mark query terms in matching text.

sort.description: How Slack should sort search results.

sortDir.description: The sort direction for Slack search results.

teamId.description: The encoded team ID to search when using an org-level token.

includeRaw.description: When true, each returned match also carries the untouched Slack search match under raw, including any blocks, attachments and files. Defaults to false.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for searching Slack messages.

channelId.description: The conversation identifier containing the message.

anyOf.description: The conversation name when Slack returns one.

channelName.description: The conversation name when Slack returns one.

userId.description: The user ID of the message author.

username.description: The username of the message author when Slack returns one.

permalink.description: A Slack permalink for the matching message.

teamId.description: The Slack team ID returned for the match.

raw.description: The untouched Slack record, exactly as the Slack API returned it. Present only when includeRaw is true.

items.description: A normalized Slack message search match.

total.description: The total number of matches Slack reports.

paging.description: Slack legacy paging metadata when returned.

anyOf.description: The cursor for the next page when Slack returns one.

nextCursor.description: The cursor for the next page when Slack returns one.

outputSchema.description: The output payload for this action.

actions.name: update_message
actions.description: Update a Slack message posted through this connection. Provide text, blocks, or attachments as the new message content.

channelId.description: The Slack conversation or channel ID.

text.description: Plain text message content. When blocks are provided, Slack uses this as notification and accessibility fallback text.

items.description: A Slack Block Kit block object. Pass the block exactly as Slack documents it.

blocks.description: Slack Block Kit blocks to render in the message.

items.description: A Slack legacy attachment object. Prefer blocks for new messages when possible.

attachments.description: Slack legacy attachments to include in the message.

unfurlLinks.description: Whether Slack should unfurl links in the message.

unfurlMedia.description: Whether Slack should unfurl media in the message.

metadata.description: Slack message metadata to attach to the message.

messageTs.description: The Slack message timestamp, for example '1711.0001'.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for updating a Slack message.

channelId.description: The conversation identifier containing the message.

messageTs.description: The timestamp identifier of the message.

outputSchema.description: The output payload for a Slack message reference.

actions.name: upload_file
actions.description: Upload a file to Slack using the current external upload flow. Provide fileUrl; binary content is fetched by the connector runtime.

filename.description: The file name Slack should display.

fileUrl.description: A URL whose response body should be uploaded to Slack.

title.description: Optional file title shown in Slack.

channelId.description: The Slack conversation or channel ID.

initialComment.description: Optional message text to post with the file.

threadTs.description: The Slack message timestamp, for example '1711.0001'.

mimeType.description: The content type to send while uploading the file.

altText.description: Alternative text for the uploaded file when Slack supports it.

snippetType.description: Slack snippet type for text snippets.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for uploading a Slack file.

urlPrivate.description: The private Slack URL for the file when returned.

items.description: A Slack file object returned by the Web API.

files.description: Files returned by Slack after completing the upload.

outputSchema.description: The output payload for this action.

configInputs.description: Slack conversation ID to watch, e.g. C0122KQ70S7E.
Only trigger on messages written by these Slack user IDs. Empty means any author.
Never trigger on messages written by these Slack user IDs.
Also trigger on messages posted by bots and apps.
Also trigger on Slack system notices.
Maximum number of messages processed per poll.
Only trigger when message text contains this string, case-insensitively.

triggers.description: Polls one Slack conversation and triggers when a new message is posted to it.
triggers.name: on_message_posted

triggerPermissions.name: New Channel Message
triggerPermissions.description: Reads conversation history to detect new messages in the selected channel. Does not send or modify messages.
triggerPermissions.instructions: Requires the history scope for the selected conversation type: channels:history, groups:history, im:history or mpim:history. Private conversations also require membership.
